notes.title: Improvements to Death's Life
notes.content:
Dear players,

Based on your feedback, we made [b]huge[/b] improvements to Death's Life:
[list]
[*]New cinematic camera[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26683297/31471e3e4813749c420fbc44262a695ed279973a.png[/img]
[*]Improved graphics[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26683297/308b0831b4b2080b8d525d0a9926e90d7d5d0f11.png[/img]
[*]New animations[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26683297/5d92818e745a7c54f222b1b80651199111ce19fb.png[/img]
[*]Revamped UI[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26683297/7ef1b22d9c68ef94c63c23cbe5f3ce7d132b7f77.jpg[/img]
[*]Gameplay changes[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26683297/6c104a316af76197a40617ac94bc02df197c0655.png[/img]
[/list]
And more:
[list]
[*]Bug fixes
[*]Steam cards are now live!
[/list]
We're always listening you and we'll have more news coming soon!

Hope you enjoy!

Kind regards,

Umbu Games Team
